# Second document {#overview}

A second document, so the reader's compare view has two panes to put side by
side. It is deliberately short: what it must do is exist, parse, and carry a
handful of citable blocks.

## A section {#section-a}

A paragraph long enough to be worth citing, with two sentences so a span can
name part of it. This is the second sentence.

Another paragraph in the same section, also long enough to stand as a block a
locator can point at without ambiguity.

## Another section {#section-b}

One more paragraph, which exists so the outline has something under the second
heading and the compare view has something to scroll.
